---
title: "About the author"
---

Erasmo Vassallo, born in 1972, is Associate Professor of Economic Statistics at the Department of Economics, Business and Statistics of the University of Palermo. In the current teaching programme, for the year 2018 he teaches economic statistics, statistical models for financial markets and methods for performance evaluation in health care in the bachelor's and master's degree programmes in statistics. He is a statistician trained in the Palermo school and, as a statistician, worked for several companies and institutions, including ISTAT, before starting his academic career under the guidance of Prof. Gaetano Cusimano. To date he is the author of 3 textbooks with leading national publishers and of about 80 scientific articles in prestigious national and international journals. He has published numerous popular articles and commentaries on statistical and economic topics in regional and national newspapers and news portals.

*Biographical note taken from the 2018 print edition.*
